summary: Futu Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of an investigation notice and administrative penalty pre-notification from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) regarding unlicensed securities, fund sales, and futures business in mainland China. The proposed penalty is approximately RMB1.85 billion (USD271 million) plus a personal fine of RMB1.25 million on CEO Li Hua. The company may submit defenses and request a hearing; it has implemented rectification measures. Funded accounts from mainland China represent ~13% of total. This regulatory enforcement action is not a special situation category but an Other material event. Monitor CSRC final determination and business impact.
